newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: South American port conditions - Lloyds.
newsitem.headline: South American port conditions - Lloyds.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

ARGENTINA, Feb 25 - Santa Fe - No vessels berthed, none in roads, none due. Max. recommended draft 28 ft. 10 ins. at access channel. Diamante - Two vessels berthed loading maize, 1 vessel in roads, 2 vessels due. Max. recommended draft 28 ft. 10 ins. at passage KM 520. San Lorenzo - Five vessels berthed, all loading, of which 1 sbo, 1 wheat, 1 sun pellets, 1 maize, 1 sun oil. 2 Vessels in roads, 20 due at 6 terminals during the present and forthcoming week. Max. recommended draft guided by Emilio Mitre channel. Forecast indicates that draft will not vary during the next week. Pasa berth draft - 26 ft. 9 ins. Fw.

Rosario - Five vessels berthed of which 2 awaiting orders. 3 Loading (1 wheat, 1 steel products, 1 maize). No vessels in roads, 9 due within this week and next. Max. recommended draft guided by Emilio Mitre channel. Forecast indicates that draft will not vary during the next week. Villa Constitucion - No vessels berthed, none in roads, 2 due. Elevator berths - Max. draft 22 ft. 0 ins. Fw. Max. recommended draft guided by Emilio Mitre channel. San Nicolas - One vessel discharging iron ore/steel. 1 Vessel in roads, 7 due over the next week. Max. recommended draft guided by Emilio Mitre channel.

San Pedro - No vessels berthed, none in roads, 4 due. Recommended draft guided by Emilio Mitre channel. Emilio Mitre channel - Max. drafts (high tide), Vessels up to 22 m beam 3,200 ft.,fw. (high tide), vessels over 22 m beam 3,106 fw. (high tide). Buenos Aires - 20 Vessels in port, 25 due within the next week. Max. recommended draft 31 ft. 6 s. Fw. high tide Naabsa (guided by entrance channel). Dock sud - Max. recommended draft 29 ft. Fw. high tide Naabsa (guided by entrance channel).

Necochea - Five vessels berthed, all loading, of which 3 wheat, 1 fish, 1 wood-chips. 5 Vessels in roads, 3 due within the next week. Max. recommended draft at entrance channel 40 ft. 0 ins. Bw. Bahia Blanca - Five vessels berthed, all loading, of which 2 wheat, 1 gasoil, 1 lpg, 1 crude oil. 1 Vessel in roads, 16 due within the next week. Drafts differ for individual berths.

CHILE, Feb 24 - Arica - Two vessels berthed and operating, 3 berths vacant, 8 vessels due during the week. Iquique - Two vessels berthed and operating, 5 berths vacant, 7 vessels due during the week. Antofagasta - Five vessels berthed, 1 berth vacant, 8 vessels due during the week to load/discharge concentrates, bulk copper, containers and general cargo. Valparaiso - Nine vessels berthed and operating, no berths vacant and no delays at present. 1 Berth (pier 3) out of service until April for enlargement. 21 Vessels due during the week, 1 days delay may be expected.

San Antonio - Three vessels in port operating, 6 berths vacant. 10 Vessels due during the week, port busy, but no waiting time. Puerto Montt - Two coasters berthed, 2 vessels due during the week. Punta Arenas - No vessels berthed, 9 due during the week. Conception Bay ports - Talcahuano - One vessel berthed and operating, 5 due this week, none waiting in roads. San Vicente - Three vessels berthed and operating, 6 due during the week, 1 days berthing delay expected. Navy pier (Molo 500) - No vessels berthed, 3 due during the week. Steel pier - 1 Vessel berthed, 1 due this week. Coronel pier - No vessels berthed. Oil terminal - 1 Vessel berthed. Lirquen - Three vessels berthed, 3 berths vacant, 5 vessels due during the week. Penco - No vessels berthed.

PERU, Feb 24 - No strikes at any port. Callao - Four vessels anchored, 5 general cargo/container vessels berthed, no berthing delays. Paita - One vessel anchored, 3 fish meal/general cargo vessels berthed. Bayovar, Pisco - No vessels, no delays. Talara - Two oil tankers anchored, no berthing delays. Chimbote - One fish meal vessel anchored, no berthing delays. Ilo - One fish meal vessel berthed, no berthing delays.

VENEZUELA, Feb 24 - Puerto Cabello - Four vessels berthed of which 3 with grain cargoes, 1 bulk cargo. Piers 1 and 2 closed, 3 vessels anchored. Guanta - Four general cargo vessels berthed, 3 vessels anchored. Feb 25 - All ports working normally. Orinoco river - Draft 25/2 - 31 ft. 0 ins. Puerto Ordaz - Two vessels operating of which loading iron ore, 1 discharging manganese, 4 vessels due. Palua - Three vessels due. Boca Grande - Two vessels due. Matanzas - Six vessels loading steel products, 3 due. Venalum - Three vessels loading aluminium. San Felix - One vessel due. Punta Cuchillo - One vessel due. La Guaira - Five vessels loading/discharging general cargo, 7 vessels due, 2 under repair.

Puerto Cabello - Seven vessels loading/discharging general cargo, 17 due. Guanta - One vessel loading/discharging general cargo, 3 due. Maracaibo - One vessel loading/discharging general cargo. Puerto Miranda - Five vessels loading crude oil. Palmarejo Sur - One vessel loading crude oil. El Tablazo - Five vessels loading urea. La Salina - Two vessels loading crude oil. Bajo Grande - Refined products terminal - 3 Vessels loading crude oil. Punta Palma, Punta Camacho, San Lorenzo, San FranCisco, Buoy B 71, La Ceiba - No vessels. Amuay - Two vessels waiting at anchorage to load, 5 vessels loading refined products. Cardon - One vessel waiting at anchorage to load, 3 loading refined products.
